Towhid Hridoy, Player of the Match: When I did the mistake, I look to learn from it. I knew what thinking I had to change. I tried to execute it. To be very honest, from my childhood, I always follow Mushfiqur bhai. He is my idol, and when I got the opportunity to bat with him, it’s obviously a privilege, and always I try to learn from him. And in the middle, I talk with him, and I told him, if you think anything, please let me know. I will try. Always I want to see the ball, play according to the ball. I tried but it will happen again (On missing a 100 in the second innings).

Jomel Warrican, Player of the Series: Honestly, that was my goal playing Test cricket, to achieve 100 Test wickets. But as a spinner, opportunities are very limited, especially as our culture is fast bowling. So for me, my target, Shane Shillingford had 70 wickets. Then for me to get 100 Test wickets, that’s one of my top achievements. I’m a strong believer in things that you get the conditions, you dominate. So for me, I’ve always come to Asia to dominate because the conditions fit for me as a spinner. So I really enjoy bowling in these type of conditions. One is consistency and approach. How you plan it, where you’re bowling, as well also watching the batsmen as well and assessing wickets, and also just being patient. That is the only key that I found with bowling, being able to hit the same area consistently over and over.

West Indies won the series when they last came to Bangladesh in 2021, and they've taken the series once more. In the process, they've hurt Bangladesh's chances in the World Test Championship. Jomel Warrican was the star for the visitors, taking 16 wickets across the two Tests. For context, the troika of Taijul Islam, Mehidy Hasan Miraz and Nayeem Hasan took 16 wickets combined in the series. The arrival of Tawhid Hridoy, though, has been the biggest positive for the hosts. In just his third Test for the country, he produced one of the greatest knocks by a Bangladesh batter to help them avoid a 2-0 whitewash. He'll be one to watch out for when they go to South Africa in less than a week. Their seam attack, led by Hasan Mahmud, should be good to watch as well, although the continued absence of Nahid Rana remains a pain point. That's all for now. Hope you enjoyed our coverage.
